purpose: Continuously improve a source-verifiable financial knowledge base and support evidence-aware advisory research; videos are inputs, not the final product

one_user_request.goal: One user instruction initiates all eligible steps without another 'continue' instruction
one_user_request.orchestrator: ChatGPT model using available file, search, GitHub and local execution tools
one_user_request.partial_results_if_limits_reached: sealed progress checkpoint plus explicit unfinished work, never a fabricated completed study

workflow.exit: Every requested original SRT identified, byte-hashed, deduplicated and ordered
All cues assessed with source references; unresolved meaning is recorded as incomplete
Claim-specific official sources searched; exact text, scope, date, exception and numeric proof / justified uncertainty saved
All new claims compared against current IRE knowledge; duplicate/complement/change/conflict candidates recorded
Relation/evidence verdicts distinguish direct source match from independent financial truth review
Append-only versioned knowledge snapshot with old and new source lineage, conflict candidates and topic clusters
For advisory questions retrieve current-time evidence with suitability assumptions, unresolved conflicts and abstention rules
Batch-wide report lists completion, unresolved work, immutable snapshot hashes, and appropriate status labels

data_layers.authority: source-linked interpretation in current chat; not a fact certificate
independently fetched official text, exact quotation, document digest, date/scope
candidate similarity vs explicitly reviewed relation; no implicit merging
append-only time-indexed claims; preserve provenance and versions
question-specific assembled evidence + current recheck + risk/suitability, not automatic trading

research_completion.COMPLETE_WITH_LIMITATIONS: All requested sources fully transcribed/meaningfully classified and compared, with explicit unresolved evidence and conflict lists; not accuracy certified
research_completion.INCOMPLETE_REQUIRES_RESUME: Any source, cue, comparison or required final report incomplete
research_completion.APPROVED_FOR_ADVISORY: Only externally validated financial facts with applicable law/date and suitability review; never conferred by unit tests or assistant self-review

history_policy.migration: V1 stored studies remain read-only; V2 overlays must be explicit and immutable
